evidence: Lighthouse detected 3 buttons without accessible names in the Updates section.
user_impact: Screen reader users may not understand the purpose of the arrow buttons or which update they navigate to.
recommended_fix: Add descriptive accessible names to each arrow button based on its corresponding update title.

evidence: Lighthouse flagged multiple carousel indicators. Inspected indicator measures approximately 7.987 × 7.987 CSS pixels.
user_impact: Users with motor difficulties may struggle to select individual carousel indicators.
recommended_fix: Increase the interactive target area to at least 24 × 24 CSS pixels, or meet an applicable WCAG exception.

page_or_component: Aadhaar Services – Navigation arrow is not keyboard-accessible.
evidence: The arrow navigates on mouse click but cannot be reached using Tab
user_impact: Keyboard-only users may be unable to access that destination.
recommended_fix: Replace the clickable <div> with a semantic link (<a>) or another keyboard-operable control.

evidence: Tamil text could not be selected normally during manual testing.
user_impact: Screen reader users may have difficulty accessing the document's content if its text layer or reading structure is broken.
recommended_fix: Provide a properly structured, tagged PDF with an accessible Tamil text layer.

evidence: During keyboard-only testing, Tab navigation skipped the Images and Videos options. Mouse interaction was required to access Videos.
user_impact: Keyboard-only users may be unable to access the Images and Videos sections
recommended_fix: Make Gallery options keyboard-accessible and ensure they can be operated using Tab and Enter/Space.
